scope: All four level-65 village story bosses; three tuned, Stormveil retained.

method.extras: no pet, bloodline, relic, consumable or resource reset
method.engine: Real production Solo resolver, or embedded multi-actor resolver where the real story start attaches it; STANDARD_PVE_AI_POLICY and STORY_VILLAGE_BIOMES.
method.playerPolicy: Visible-state deterministic heuristic: damage, movement, basic healing, Clear and Cleanse. No future enemy-turn search; does not optimize every self-effect on opponent-targeting utility techniques.
method.limits: Eight deterministic loadout examples per boss establish viable clears and pressure; these are not human win rates or proof for every build.

changes.preserved: Other 33 story templates exactly match captured baseline; Stormveil65 and Frostfang35 formation scales remain 1 and .5. IDs, portraits, ability identities, targeting, costs, cooldowns, turn rules, rewards and progression unchanged.

contextCorrection: Earlier group-only report approximated village biomes. This audit uses actual story-gate biomes for both before and after. Stormveil is central, so its unchanged result here is 18–31% HP rather than the earlier forest-fixture result. No Stormveil production retune occurred in this pass.
fieldMethod: Boss-start prefers the current sector biome while travelling. For all five actual sector biomes use the same eight legal builds with a fixed visible-state policy: heal below 55% and use ready zero-damage opponent-targeting utility techniques. This is a separate counterplay check, not the standard 45%-heal pressure benchmark. All 160 clear; some strong terrain matchups finish above 40%.
